findings.title: Call to zero-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.java line 47 calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only definition in parent UsernamePasswordForm.java takes a UserModel argument (isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)). There is no zero-arg overload. The module will fail to compile, so the PR is unmergeable as shown.

findings.title: Passkeys conditional-UI setup now skipped when no user is selected
findings.body: Old code in authenticate() called webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) whenever passkeys were enabled. New code gates it with isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), which requires user != null (same gate added in challenge() at line 137). On the initial username/password page context.getUser() is null, so no challenge, RP-ID, or ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI is set up. That breaks usernameless/discoverable passkey login and autofill on first render, while the fix was only meant to add setup for the re-authentication case where user != null. The gate should be passkeys-enabled, not user != null.
